A CLOSER LOOK, ONE FILE AT A TIME

01 / SEE THE CHANGE

Read before you release.

Open a repository or a local review link. Color-coded files and staged or working diffs help you find your place.

Ask a better AI question.

Highlight code, preview a prompt, then copy it into Codex or ChatGPT. You choose what to send and where.

IN DEVELOPMENT

Windows

A separate review client is underway, with Git diffs, AI prompts, and the same local-first approach.

Windows preview is being tested.

An unsigned x64 installer has been built. Public download follows Windows verification. It will initially have fewer features than the Mac app.

Your repository stays with you.

Git Boy reads local repositories. Ask AI prepares text for you to copy; it does not automatically send your code to a model. Local review links need the checkout on the computer opening them. Git operations you explicitly request can contact your configured remotes.
